description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Jacksonville / Northeast Florida market through PTF-JACKSONVILLE-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 155 of this market's 268 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Jacksonville at 95 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 268 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-JACKSONVILLE-FL-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the West-Palm-Beach-live hardened lineage and closed in that same order through the supported attended-browser lane (120 paced attempts, 75 first-party brand reads, no paid provider, no relay, no browser-JS exfiltration and no Akamai bypass), registered by PTF-JACKSONVILLE-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 17 corridors over 47 admitted postal codes across FOUR counties, three of them SPLIT. DUVAL is admitted whole because it is a consolidated city-county whose single postal city name covers 25 lodging-bearing codes over 39 miles; CLAY is admitted except Keystone Heights, which is 45 miles inland in the Trail Ridge lake district and orients to Gainesville; NASSAU is admitted with Amelia Island at CORRIDOR tier and the mainland at FRINGE; and ST. JOHNS is admitted only at Ponte Vedra Beach and Fruit Cove. EVERY ST. AUGUSTINE POSTAL CODE IS REFUSED -- 110 hotel-rank licences under the city names, 29 more in 32080 and 9 in 32092 -- because that is a market in its own right and absorbing it would destroy a future one; Flagler, Putnam, Baker, Alachua and Volusia are likewise named, refused and preserved. JAX airport IS a corridor because it owns 32218, the market's largest hotel-rank code; JAXPORT, Naval Station Mayport, NAS Jacksonville and the Mayo Clinic campus are NOT corridors because none owns a hotel-bearing postal code and Mayport and NAS Jax carry zero lodging licences at all. The city name JACKSONVILLE decides nothing here: jacksonville-nc is a LIVE market in Onslow County, North Carolina, and membership is decided by the property's own postal code and never by its name. Resort condominium units, vacation dwellings, non-transient apartments, rental-management portfolios, member-only club lodging and timeshare inventory are never admitted -- Nassau County alone carries 1,130 resort-condominium licences against 32 hotel-rank ones. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 33 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 458 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 217 NON_LODGING; 1031 OUTSIDE_MARKET.

reconciliation.note: 95 clean pet-friendly and 18 clean verified-no-pets over a 268-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one brand page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 155 identities did not publish (53 ACCESS_BLOCKED; 22 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 12 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 43 ROUTING_HOLD; 25 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in jacksonville_fl_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/jacksonville-fl/. 10 of 17 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
